lesson: Entering read classes as open device nodes is not a neutral record edit. The generator keeps a fixed number of device partners per anchor and weights open devices above the floored one, so eleven new nodes replaced 58 of the top 60 and dropped 13 former candidates from enumeration. Staging the reruns (rows and controls, then nodes, then lane lines) gave each change one cause. Node text that says "map row X" makes the builder attach that row and its controls to the node.
